member.name: T:UMapx.Imaging.BitmapWebp
member.summary: Converts Windows bitmaps to and from WebP images.
member.remarks: Supports Windows x86 and x64. Image metadata is not preserved. Concurrent encodes must use separate input bitmaps.

member.name: M:UMapx.Imaging.BitmapWebp.FromWebp(System.Byte[])
member.summary: Decodes a still WebP image to a bitmap.
member.returns: A bitmap in if the image has an alpha channel, or otherwise. The caller must dispose it.
member.exception: The image is empty, invalid or incomplete.

member.name: M:UMapx.Imaging.BitmapWebp.ToWebp(System.Drawing.Bitmap)
member.summary: Converts a bitmap to lossless WebP. RGB values of fully transparent pixels may change.
member.param: A 24bpp RGB or 32bpp ARGB bitmap, from 1 to 16383 pixels in each dimension.
member.returns: The encoded WebP image.
member.exception: The pixel format is unsupported or a dimension exceeds 16383 pixels.

member.name: M:UMapx.Imaging.BitmapWebp.ToWebp(System.Drawing.Bitmap,System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary: Converts a bitmap to lossy WebP with the specified quality and compression effort.
member.param: A 24bpp RGB or 32bpp ARGB bitmap, from 1 to 16383 pixels in each dimension.
Color and alpha quality from 0 to 100. Color compression remains lossy at 100.
Compression effort from 0 to 9. Higher values request more effort.
member.returns: The encoded WebP image.
member.remarks: Alpha values may change below quality 100. The caller retains ownership of .
member.exception: Quality is outside 0 to 100 or speed is outside 0 to 9.
The pixel format is unsupported or a dimension exceeds 16383 pixels.
